description: This file defines the 'File' class within the 'ZipStream' namespace, responsible for creating and managing ZIP file entries, including processing data streams, generating headers and footers, and handling compression and encoding for files within a ZIP archive.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file in a ZIP archive, managing data processing, headers, compression, and stream handling for ZIP entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ZIP file entry with the specified archive object, filename, and optional configuration options.

methods.name: processPath
methods.description: Reads the file path, processes its data or streams it if large, and handles compression as configured.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Processes raw data, computing CRC and length, optionally deflates it, and prepares it for ZIP entry.

methods.name: addFileHeader
methods.description: Creates and sends the ZIP local file header for this file entry, including filename and metadata.

methods.name: filterFilename
methods.description: Sanitizes filenames by removing or replacing illegal characters to ensure compatibility.

methods.name: addFileFooter
methods.description: Creates and sends the data descriptor footer for the file, updating total length and registering it in the archive.

methods.name: getCdrFile
methods.description: Constructs and returns the central directory record for this file.

methods.name: getTotalLength
methods.description: Returns the total length of the file data plus headers and footers.

methods.name: dosTime
methods.description: Converts a UNIX timestamp to a DOS timestamp used in ZIP headers.

methods.name: buildZip64ExtraBlock
methods.description: Builds the ZIP64 extension block for large files or offsets if necessary.
